title: Macquarie University
description: Macquarie University's official GEM design system defines the primary colours Red (#A6192E), Charcoal (#373A36), Sand light (#EDEBE5), Purple (#80225F), Deep red (#76232F), Bright red (#D6001C) and Magenta (#C6007E), and the secondary colours Success (#009174), Alert (#BC4700), Information (#415364), Sand (#D6D2C4) and Dark Purple (#6F1D46).
